ticker_news.title: Tesla Board Members Rake In Over $3 Billion In Stock Awards Despite 2021 Pay Freeze: Report
ticker_news.description: Tesla board members have collectively earned over $3 billion in stock awards, significantly higher than other tech companies, despite agreeing to halt director compensation in 2021. Key board members like Kimbal Musk have made nearly $1 billion since 2004, raising concerns about excessive compensation.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Tesla Could Hit A $2 Trillion Market Cap By 2026 — And Even $3 Trillion In A Bull Case As Its 'AI Chapter' Finally Takes Hold, Says Top Analyst
ticker_news.description: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives predicts Tesla could reach a $2 trillion market cap by 2026, potentially hitting $3 trillion in a bull scenario, driven by advancements in autonomous driving and AI technologies.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Prediction: Elon Musk Will Reveal Tesla Is Already Losing Money in Q4
ticker_news.description: Tesla may report a net loss in Q4 2025 due to declining EV sales, reduced tax credits, cheaper vehicle models, and rising operating expenses, potentially marking a challenging financial quarter for the company.
ticker_news.author: John Bromels
